description:
Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base; 10 signed-wallet free calls shared over rolling 30 days. Read the backend 402 body for x402 terms. Inspect a canonical Base USDC transaction receipt for the configured Wever recipient and return the observed payment details.
Operating boundary: Supply the receipt reference. Read the chain, recipient, amount and verification result. An agent links the receipt to its work record; a human inspects the same transaction details.
POST /api/payment-authority-inspector. Existing product credentials, signed mandates, and single-use action grants remain required where applicable. This adapter grants no authority and never supplies server credentials. This current money service follows its published inspection, policy evaluation or private invoice contract. Payment is an API access fee and grants no spending authority.
name: wever_payment-authority-inspector
title: Payment Authority Inspector
